answer.label: quantized
answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.096, rising to 0.184 at layer 8 and staying nearly flat (0.194 at layer 16, 0.205 at layer 24) before ending at 0.255. That matches the quantized profile. Effective rank is 4.09 and direction consistency 0.514, so the difference looks like noise. The mid-layer size ratio is 0.968, an exact match for quantized, whereas fine-tuned grows (1.017+) and system-prompted is 0.976+. The layer-2 spike of 0.1 is tiny, far from the 31.7+ seen for system-prompted. Logit changes are the smallest category: KL 0.039, top-1 agreement 0.957, TV 0.040. Median first divergence of 8.5 and edit distance of 0.51 are close to the quantized ranges. Text rates stay near the reference. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the flat mid-layer profile, the shrinking internal state and the high effective rank. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
